name: execution-efficient-composite
notes: z(GP/TA) + z(revenue_growth / capex_intensity) sector-neutral composite. Combines program's best fundamental signal (GP/TA, H227) with best capital-efficiency signal (efficiency ratio, H287). Buy/hold band (buy top-20%, hold until top-50%) + bi-monthly (42d) rebalance. Execution-aware version of H290 3-factor composite — 2 factors avoids dilution.
